scope: Chronological evidence for every Explorer record, assembled from preserved IANA data, formal ICANN application archaeology including the complete local 2000/2004/2012 application-string graph, and curated local evidence. Browser-time gTLD contract/lifecycle enrichment is disabled; the 2026 Reveal Day string inventory is handled separately by the Explorer enrichment layer.
ccTldMethod: IANA registration plus delegation/redelegation reports; gTLD Registry Agreement fields are not applied to ccTLDs.
evidenceRule: No missing date or historical phase is inferred. Only attributable, dated source evidence is rendered as a factual life-history event.
knownLimitation: Some early TLD operator changes predate central structured records and may remain undocumented in this dataset.
freezePolicy: The documented external lifecycle source is not requested or merged in the visitor browser. The complete 2012 application-string/applicant graph is already vendored locally; the 2026 individual application layer remains pending Reveal Day.
